title: *Mth 501 gdb Solution*
text:
*Mth 501 gdb Solution*

My preference: A combination of both — quantitative techniques as the base, adjusted by qualitative judgment.

Argument 1: Quantitative techniques (trend analysis, ratio analysis, regression) are based on real data and statistical analysis, so the forecast is objective, measurable, and consistent. They tell exactly how many employees, with which skills, will be needed, and they remove personal bias from the plan.

Argument 2: In a dynamic and unpredictable market, past data alone cannot capture sudden changes such as new technology, restructuring, or economic shifts. Qualitative judgment (managers' experience and knowledge of upcoming changes) adjusts the statistical forecast to the real situation, making the plan practical and realistic.
